from sceneact import *
import bpy
import math

# Visible inventory: pale island and slab top, three handleless drawer bands,
# suspended stone hood, dark rear cabinetry and oven stack, lit backsplash niche,
# red kettle, exposed timber columns, tiled floor, open dark ceiling and beams.
# Estimated landmarks (384x512): island near corner (238,322), base (238,432);

# Camera height and room depth are uncertain; use a coherent metre-scale scene.
scene = Scene('Kitchen showroom')
ivory = (.65,.66,.63)
dark = (.045,.052,.050)
black = (.015,.020,.019)
stone = (.72,.72,.66)
wood = (.37,.225,.115)

def cube(parent, key, size, center, color):
    return parent.include(key, box(size=size, center=center, color=color))

# Fine tile joints remain restrained, with large rectangular porcelain tiles.
for i in range(-5,6):
    cube(room, 'floor_joint_x_%d' % i, (.008,12,.0015),
         (i*1.25,0,.001), (.40,.41,.38))

         (0,i*1.25,.001), (.40,.41,.38))

for i, x in enumerate([-3,-1.3,.5,2.3,4.1]):

for i in range(15):

         (-4+i*.57,0,4.135), (.012,.017,.016))

island = scene.include('island', Asset('Pale kitchen island'))

     (ix,iy,.05), (.17,.18,.17))
cube(island, 'carcass', (L,D,.80), (ix,iy,.50), ivory)
cube(island, 'solid_left_end', (.075,D,.86),

for i, (z,h) in enumerate([(.235,.245),(.498,.245),(.761,.245)]):

cube(island, 'countertop', (L+.035,D+.035,.035),
     (ix,iy,.9575), (.80,.81,.76))
# Pale inset induction area, narrow seams rather than dark heavy detailing.
cube(island, 'flush_hob', (.77,.53,.003),
     (ix-.47,iy-.02,.977), (.71,.73,.69))
for i, xx in enumerate([ix-.69,ix-.29]):
    cube(island, 'hob_zone_%d' % i, (.29,.37,.0015),
         (xx,iy-.02,.979), (.75,.77,.72))
# Sink located toward the far end of the work surface.
cube(island, 'sink_rim', (.47,.38,.006),
     (ix+.64,iy+.16,.979), (.58,.61,.58))
cube(island, 'sink_basin', (.405,.315,.007),
     (ix+.64,iy+.16,.981), (.38,.43,.41))
cube(island, 'sink_inner', (.33,.25,.008),

    points=[(ix+.65,iy+.41,.98),(ix+.65,iy+.41,1.19),
            (ix+.65,iy+.37,1.23),(ix+.65,iy+.22,1.23),
            (ix+.65,iy+.19,1.19)],

    color=(.57,.60,.58)))

         (-2.28+i*.605,1.805,2.12), (.064,.071,.066))
cube(kitchen, 'warm_niche_back', (2.75,.02,.36),
     (-.62,2.21,1.19), (.29,.23,.19))
cube(kitchen, 'strip_light', (2.72,.035,.014),
     (-.62,1.86,1.392), (.93,.79,.60))

# Tall left cabinet silhouette with tiny horizontal reveals.
cube(kitchen, 'left_tall_cabinet', (.73,.83,2.52),
     (-2.96,1.82,1.26), (.046,.052,.049))
for i, z in enumerate([.89,2.17]):

         (-2.96,1.402,z), (.025,.030,.028))

tower = scene.include('oven_bank', Asset('Right oven cabinet bank'))
cube(tower, 'tower_body', (.91,.82,2.46),
     (1.93,1.90,1.23), (.055,.061,.057))
cube(tower, 'left_trim', (.07,.035,1.32),
     (1.52,1.472,1.28), (.14,.15,.14))
for i, z in enumerate([1.00,1.62]):
    cube(tower, 'oven_metal_frame_%d' % i, (.69,.035,.55),
         (1.93,1.472,z), (.29,.31,.29))
    cube(tower, 'oven_glass_%d' % i, (.59,.015,.38),

cube(tower, 'bottom_door', (.72,.025,.54),
     (1.93,1.473,.29), (.065,.070,.064))
# Broad gray surround and dark tall plane at far right.

cube(kettle, 'base', (.23,.18,.025), (-.63,1.88,.98), (.018,.019,.018))

# Procedural wood grain and lightly mottled pale stone, applied through groups.
def descendants(obj):
    yield obj
    for child in obj.children:
        yield from descendants(child)

def material_for_group(group_name, factory):
    marker = bpy.data.objects.get(group_name)
    if marker:
        for obj in descendants(marker):
            if obj.type == 'MESH':
                mat = factory()
                obj.data.materials.clear()
                obj.data.materials.append(mat)

def wood_material():
    m = bpy.data.materials.new('Warm oak vertical grain')
    m.use_nodes = True
    n, l = m.node_tree.nodes, m.node_tree.links
    bs = n.get('Principled BSDF')
    bs.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = .62
    tex = n.new('ShaderNodeTexNoise')
    tex.inputs['Scale'].default_value = 4.0
    tex.inputs['Detail'].default_value = 3.5
    coord = n.new('ShaderNodeTexCoord')
    mapping = n.new('ShaderNodeVectorMath')
    mapping.operation = 'MULTIPLY'
    mapping.inputs[1].default_value = (7,7,.20)
    l.new(coord.outputs['Generated'], mapping.inputs[0])
    l.new(mapping.outputs[0], tex.inputs['Vector'])
    ramp = n.new('ShaderNodeValToRGB')
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position = .20
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color = (.16,.075,.028,1)
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position = .82
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = (.51,.33,.18,1)
    l.new(tex.outputs['Fac'], ramp.inputs[0])
    l.new(ramp.outputs[0], bs.inputs['Base Color'])
    bump = n.new('ShaderNodeBump')
    bump.inputs['Strength'].default_value = .19
    bump.inputs['Distance'].default_value = .016
    l.new(tex.outputs['Fac'], bump.inputs['Height'])
    l.new(bump.outputs[0], bs.inputs['Normal'])
    return m

material_for_group('timber_posts', wood_material)

def plaster_material():
    m = bpy.data.materials.new('Fine pale limestone')
    m.use_nodes = True
    n, l = m.node_tree.nodes, m.node_tree.links
    bs = n.get('Principled BSDF')
    bs.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (.70,.70,.64,1)
    bs.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = .82
    noise = n.new('ShaderNodeTexNoise')
    noise.inputs['Scale'].default_value = 65
    noise.inputs['Detail'].default_value = 2
    bump = n.new('ShaderNodeBump')
    bump.inputs['Strength'].default_value = .16
    bump.inputs['Distance'].default_value = .008
    l.new(noise.outputs['Fac'], bump.inputs['Height'])
    l.new(bump.outputs[0], bs.inputs['Normal'])
    return m
material_for_group('stone_shell', plaster_material)
